title: Generative Retrieval for E-commerce: Jointly Learning Embedding and Codebook with Same Product Cluster
title_zh: 面向电子商务的生成式检索：结合相同商品簇联合学习 Embedding 与 Codebook
abstract_en: With the development of large language models (LLMs), generative retrieval is becoming increasingly important in e-commerce scenarios. Current mainstream approaches typically use a two-stage training strategy: first train a product embedding model, and then learn a codebook that maps embeddings to product IDs. This cascaded approach suffers from two major issues: (1) error accumulation-if the embedding model in the first stage produces biased representations, the codebook in the second stage cannot correct these errors, degrading final retrieval performance; and (2) codebook learning relies solely on product embeddings and lacks modeling of query-to-product and product-to-product interactions. As a result, products belonging to the same cluster may be assigned inconsistent IDs by the codebook, further hurting retrieval accuracy. To address these problems, we propose a novel method that jointly trains the embedding model and the codebook, and incorporates same product cluster information as an additional supervision signal. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves e-commerce retrieval performance while simultaneously enhancing both embedding and codebook learning.
abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的发展，生成式检索在电子商务中日益重要。现有方法通常采用两阶段训练：先训练商品 Embedding 模型，再学习将 Embedding 映射到商品 ID 的 Codebook。这种级联方案存在误差累积问题，且 Codebook 仅依赖商品 Embedding，无法充分建模 Query-to-Product 和 Product-to-Product 交互，导致同一商品簇中的商品可能被分配不一致的 ID。为此，论文提出一种联合训练 Embedding 模型与 Codebook 的方法，并引入相同商品簇信息作为额外监督信号。实验表明，该方法能够显著提升电子商务检索性能，同时改善 Embedding 和 Codebook 的学习效果。
key_points_zh: 指出两阶段生成式检索存在误差累积：第一阶段 Embedding 的偏差难以被第二阶段 Codebook 修正。
指出仅基于商品 Embedding 学习 Codebook，难以建模 Query-to-Product 和 Product-to-Product 交互。
提出联合训练 Embedding 模型与 Codebook，避免级联训练带来的信息割裂。
引入相同商品簇（same product cluster）监督，促使同簇商品获得更一致、更合理的检索 ID。
实验显示，该方法同时提升 Embedding 学习、Codebook 学习及整体电子商务检索性能。

llm_assessment.comment: A directly relevant e-commerce retrieval contribution that improves generative retrieval by jointly learning product representations and codebooks.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作直接面向电商检索，通过联合学习商品表示与码本提升了生成式检索效果。
